newsitem.title: UK: BA up as brokers repeat positive views.
newsitem.headline: BA up as brokers repeat positive views.

text.p: Shares in British Airways climbed on Thursday as NatWest Securities and ABN AMRO Hoare Govett reiterated their positive stances on the stock, market sources said.
Hoare Govett repeated its "buy" recommendation on the back of solid interim results and expectations of a successful conclusion to proposals for a link-up with American Airlines.
NatWest also retained its "add" recommendation though it edged pre-tax profit forecasts slightly lower, sources said.
BA shares added 9-1/2p to 572p in a weaker overall market.
Dealers also said speculation about progress in talks between U.S. and British officials on an "open skies" agreement was also helping the shares.
